sections.title: Quick Take: Which LIC Term Insurance Plan Is Best?

content.text: When choosing an LIC term insurance plan, most buyers who want low cost plus high trust will find that the LIC New Tech-Term is the best overall LIC term life insurance choice due to its competitive online-only premium. If you prefer in-person guidance from an agent, consider its offline counterpart, Jeevan Amar. I generally advise against Return-of-Premium (ROP) plans like Jeevan Kiran unless you strongly prefer a guaranteed return of capital over cost efficiency, as they are significantly more expensive for the same cover.

Get a free LIC term quote in 2 minutes. Enter your age & desired cover to see your estimated premium for a ₹1 crore policy. No obligation.

We used live premium examples from market aggregators (PolicyBazaar, PolicyX) for common scenarios. This LIC term insurance premium calculator helps you get an exact quote for your profile—premiums for a LIC term insurance 1 crore policy differ widely by age and product.

sections.title: Which LIC Term Insurance Plans Exist? (Product List & UINs)

content.text:
LIC New Tech-Term (Plan No. 954, UIN: 512N339V02)

This is LIC’s flagship online-only, non-participating pure-risk premium plan. What is the LIC Tech Term plan? Because it's sold directly online, it offers the most competitive premium from LIC, including an online rebate. It's ideal for self-directed buyers comfortable with online processes who want to buy LIC term insurance online. Official LIC Page

  • Eligibility: Entry age 18-65, policy term 10-40 years.

LIC New Jeevan Amar (Plan No. 955, UIN: 512N338V02)

This is the offline version of Tech-Term, offering nearly identical features but sold through agents. The premium is slightly higher to account for agent commissions. The main difference between Tech Term and Jeevan Amar is this sales channel and the resulting price. Official LIC Page

LIC Jeevan Kiran (Plan No. 870, UIN: 512N359V02)

This is a 'Return of Premium' (ROP) plan. You pay a higher premium, but if you survive the policy term, LIC returns all premiums paid. The LIC Jeevan Kiran return of premium is explained as a feature for those who dislike pure risk, but financially, it is often better to buy a cheaper pure term plan and invest the difference. Official LIC Page

sections.title: How LIC Term Premiums Are Calculated

content.text: Premiums for any LIC term insurance plan reflect actuarial risk: younger age = lower premium, smokers pay materially more, higher sum assured costs more, and longer terms increase cost. Use the LIC term insurance calculator above for exact quotes tailored to your age, gender, smoker status and PPT.

sections.title: LIC vs Private Insurers — Premium & Feature Comparison

content.text: LIC's term plans are backed by the corporation’s nationwide service network and a long history of paying claims, making it the natural choice for buyers who value offline support and brand trust. Recent online plans like Tech-Term now offer competitive pricing for self-service buyers looking for a great LIC term life insurance policy.

rows: Generally 15-30% higher, but online plans are competitive. A 'LIC tech term vs HDFC life' comparison often shows LIC is now closer in price.
Often more innovative features (e.g., increasing cover, multiple payout options)

content.text:
Worthwhile Add-ons for your LIC Term Insurance Plan:
  • Accidental Death & Disability Benefit Rider (AD&DB): Does the LIC term plan cover accidental death? Yes, if you add this rider. It's a must-have, providing an extra payout in case of an accident.
  • Critical Illness Rider (CI): Provides a lump sum on diagnosis of major illnesses. A good alternative to a separate health insurance top-up.
What to Avoid:
  • Return of Premium (ROP) Plans: As discussed with Jeevan Kiran, these plans are far more expensive. Is return of premium term insurance worth it? Financially, it's often better to buy a cheaper pure term plan and invest the difference.
This is where LIC's reputation shines. The process to claim LIC term insurance after death is straightforward:

items: The nominee must intimate the claim by submitting the filled claim form along with the original death certificate, policy documents, and KYC papers at the servicing branch.
LIC verifies the claim. As per IRDAI regulations, non-investigated claims must be settled within 30 days of receiving all documents.
If an investigation is required (usually only for early claims), the timeline can extend up to 120 days.

Claim Settlement Ratio (CSR): LIC consistently reports one of the highest individual death claim settlement ratios in the industry. As of the latest annual report for FY2022-23, their CSR was 98.52%. (Source: LIC Annual Report / Reuters).

items.q: What is the LIC Tech-Term Plan and how is it different?
items.a: LIC's New Tech-Term (Plan 954) is an online-only pure risk premium plan. It is different because it is cheaper than its offline counterpart, Jeevan Amar, as it offers a rebate for online sales, cutting out agent commissions. It is a popular choice for those looking to buy a simple LIC term life insurance plan.

items.q: How much premium for ₹1 Crore LIC term insurance for a 30-year-old non-smoker?
items.a: The premium varies by plan and mode, but for a 30-year-old non-smoker seeking a ₹1 Crore cover until age 60, the yearly premium for a Tech-Term plan is approximately ₹12,000-₹15,000. This translates to roughly ₹1,000-₹1,300 per month. Use our LIC term insurance premium calculator 1 crore for a precise quote.

items.q: Does LIC settle term claims reliably?
items.a: Yes. LIC has one of the highest Claim Settlement Ratios (CSR) in the industry, consistently above 98% (98.52% for FY 2022-23), indicating high reliability.

items.q: Can I buy LIC term insurance online?
items.a: Absolutely. LIC offers the 'New Tech-Term' plan specifically for online purchase. The process involves visiting LIC's official website, filling out the proposal form, uploading documents, and paying the premium online.

items.q: Does the LIC term insurance plan cover accidental death and critical illness?
items.a: The base LIC term insurance plan covers death due to any reason. However, for specific coverage like accidental death or critical illness, you must purchase the respective optional riders for an additional premium.

items.q: What is the minimum sum assured for an LIC term plan in 2025?
items.a: For most popular LIC term plans like New Tech-Term and Jeevan Amar, the minimum Basic Sum Assured is ₹25,00,000.

items.q: Can I change the nominee in my LIC term policy online?
items.a: Currently, the process for changing a nominee in an LIC policy is primarily offline. You need to submit a written request using the prescribed form at your servicing LIC branch.

items.q: Is LIC term insurance good in 2025?
items.a: Yes, for individuals who prioritize trust and a strong claim settlement record over having the absolute lowest premium, LIC term insurance remains an excellent choice in 2025. Its online plans have made it more price-competitive as well.

items.q: What documents are required to buy an LIC term plan?
items.a: You will typically need Proof of Identity (Aadhaar, PAN Card), Proof of Address, and Proof of Income (Salary Slips, ITR). The 'lic term plan documents required' are standard across insurers. A medical examination may also be required.

content.text: Case Study 1: Raj, the Early Planner. Raj, a 28-year-old software engineer in Mumbai, bought a ₹1 Crore LIC term insurance plan until age 65. His premium was just ₹1,200/month. By buying early, he locked in a low rate for his entire working life, ensuring his family's security for a minimal cost.

Case Study 2: Sunita, the Late Starter. Sunita, a 45-year-old business owner in Delhi, realized she was underinsured. She opted for a ₹1.5 Crore cover until age 70. Her premium was higher, around ₹4,500/month, but it gave her immense peace of mind knowing her business and family were protected during her peak earning years.

LIC term insurance offers an unparalleled combination of trust and security. While private players might offer slightly lower premiums, the peace of mind that comes with a government-backed policy is invaluable for many. For most users, the LIC Tech-Term plan offers the best balance of low cost and high trust.
